review.pr-review: Reviews a PR, or a stack of PRs, three ways (correctness, type safety, comments) and merges it all into one report.
review.comment-audit: Goes through every comment a branch adds and says whether to keep, trim, move or delete it.
review.type-safety-review: Finds loose types in a diff: any and mixed, untyped arrays that should be DTOs, unchecked casts.
review.pr-comments: Turns review findings into line-anchored PR comments, graded by severity.
review.writing-comments: What belongs in a code comment, and what to cut.

investigate.brief: Maps a path before anyone reads code: callers, wiring, blast radius and installed versions.
investigate.deep: A full investigation of a module: one brief, two independent passes, and only the findings both agree on.
investigate.spec: Checks a spec, ticket or plan claim by claim against the actual code.

laravel.laravel-activity-logging: Audit trails with spatie/laravel-activitylog: who did what, and when.
laravel.laravel-controllers: Thin HTTP controllers with no domain logic.
laravel.laravel-database-optimization: Faster queries, indexes, caching and eager loading.
laravel.laravel-dtos: Data transfer objects with Spatie Laravel Data.
laravel.laravel-enums: Backed enums with labels and behaviour.
laravel.laravel-models: Eloquent model patterns and the database layer.
laravel.laravel-owasp-security: An OWASP Top 10 audit for Laravel + Inertia apps.
laravel.laravel-services: Service layer for external APIs with Saloon.
laravel.laravel-value-objects: Immutable value objects for domain values.
laravel.php-best-practices: Modern PHP 8 patterns, PSR and SOLID.

inertia-react.shadcn: Add, fix and compose shadcn components.
